games.title: Slope
games.blurb: One wrong move and it is over. Slope is a fast reaction test built around a ball, a narrow track, and escalating speed.
games.annotation: IT LOOKS SIMPLE... BUT IT ISN’T.
games.subtitle: FASTER. STEEPER. NO BRAKES.
games.description: Guide a rolling ball down an endless neon track. Dodge red obstacles, stay on the platforms, and react as the speed increases. One mistake sends the ball off the course.
games.controls: [A / D] or [← / →] to steer · [SPACE] to restart · Mouse / touch supported
games.cheatCode: Hold a steady line and make small corrections rather than oversteering near the edges.

games.title: Subway Surfers: San Francisco
games.blurb: Dash through the San Francisco subway, dodge trains, and keep the run alive.
games.annotation: THREE LANES. ZERO TIME TO THINK.
games.subtitle: THE TRANSIT OFFICER IS RIGHT BEHIND YOU.
games.description: Run through the San Francisco subway system while avoiding trains, barriers, and other obstacles. Switch lanes, jump, and roll to keep moving.
games.controls: [← / →] change lanes · [↑] jump · [↓] roll · Follow any on-screen instructions

games.title: Retro Bowl
games.blurb: Build a team, manage your roster, and lead your football franchise to a championship.
games.annotation: CALL THE PLAY. MAKE THE DRIVE.
games.subtitle: BUILD YOUR TEAM. WIN THE TITLE.
games.description: A retro-inspired American football game that combines on-field action with team management. Make roster decisions, guide your offense, and try to build a championship-winning franchise.
games.controls: Mouse / touch to navigate menus · Use the in-game prompts for passing and gameplay

games.title: Minecraft Parkour
games.blurb: Jump across floating platforms and reach the finish without falling.
games.annotation: ONE BAD JUMP AND YOU’RE BACK.
games.subtitle: DONT FALL. REACH THE END.
games.description: A Minecraft-style parkour challenge built around precision jumping. Move across floating blocks, time your jumps, and reach the end of the course without falling.
games.controls: [W / A / S / D] move · [SPACE] jump · Mouse / touch where supported

games.title: Geometry Dash
games.blurb: Jump through a fast rhythm platformer full of spikes, hazards, and timed obstacles.
games.subtitle: JUMP ON THE BEAT.
games.description: Guide a geometric icon through challenging platforming sections. Time each jump to avoid spikes and obstacles while moving in sync with the level’s rhythm.
games.controls: [SPACE] / [↑] / Mouse click or tap to jump

games.title: Minecraft Pocket Edition
games.blurb: Explore a block-based world, gather resources, craft, and build.
games.annotation: A WORLD BUILT ONE BLOCK AT A TIME.
games.subtitle: EXPLORE. BUILD. SURVIVE.
games.description: A browser-playable Minecraft-style sandbox. Explore a block-based world, collect materials, craft items, and build your own structures. The available features may differ from the official Pocket Edition.
games.controls: [W / A / S / D] move · Mouse to look / interact · [SPACE] jump · Follow in-game prompts

games.title: Among Us
games.blurb: Work with a crew, complete tasks, and figure out who is sabotaging the mission.
games.annotation: SOMEONE IS NOT WHO THEY SAY.
games.subtitle: FINISH YOUR TASKS. FIND THE IMPOSTOR.
games.description: A social deduction game set aboard a spaceship. Crew members complete tasks and investigate suspicious behavior while impostors try to sabotage the mission without being discovered.
games.controls: Keyboard to move · Mouse to interact with menus and tasks · Follow in-game prompts

games.title: Angry Birds
games.blurb: Launch birds at structures and use their abilities to knock down the pigs.
games.subtitle: PULL BACK. LET FLY.
games.description: A physics-based puzzle game. Use a slingshot to launch birds at structures, destroy obstacles, and defeat the pigs with as few shots as possible.
games.controls: Click / tap and drag the slingshot backward, then release to launch

games.title: Bad Piggies
games.blurb: Build strange vehicles from parts and get the pigs safely to the goal.
games.annotation: THE PLAN IS QUESTIONABLE. THE ENGINEERING IS WORSE.
games.subtitle: BUILD IT. TEST IT. GET THERE.
games.description: A construction and physics puzzle game. Assemble vehicles from available parts, then test your inventions to move the pigs through each level and reach the objective.
games.controls: Mouse / touch to build and select parts · Use the in-game controls to operate your vehicle

games.title: Baseball Bros
games.blurb: Step onto the diamond for quick baseball matches, big hits, and defensive plays.
games.subtitle: SWING FOR THE FENCES.
games.description: A quick-play baseball game featuring batting, pitching, and fielding. Compete in matches and try to outscore your opponent. Online features depend on the game service being available.
games.controls: Keyboard / mouse · Check the in-game control guide for the current match mode

games.title: Basket Bros
games.blurb: Play fast arcade basketball matches and battle for points on the court.
games.subtitle: TAKE IT TO THE RIM.
games.description: An arcade basketball game with quick matches, exaggerated moves, and competitive play. Choose a player and try to outscore your opponent.
games.controls: Keyboard controls · Check the in-game control guide for the selected mode

games.title: Retro Ping Pong
games.blurb: A minimalist retro table-tennis game where timing and positioning decide the point.
games.annotation: KEEP YOUR EYE ON THE BALL.
games.subtitle: OLD-SCHOOL PADDLE ACTION.
games.description: A classic-style ping-pong game. Move your paddle to return the ball, control the rally, and score points against the opposing player or computer.
games.controls: Keyboard controls · Check the game screen for player-specific keys

games.title: Rooftop Snipers 2
games.blurb: A fast rooftop duel where timing your jumps and shots is the key to winning.
games.subtitle: JUMP. AIM. KNOCK THEM OFF.
games.description: A physics-based two-player duel. Jump and fire to knock your opponent off the rooftop while trying to stay on the platform yourself.
games.controls: Player controls are shown in-game; use the keyboard to jump and shoot

games.title: Rocket League
games.blurb: Drive, accelerate, and use your car to send the ball toward the opponent’s goal.
games.subtitle: DRIVE. HIT. SCORE.
games.description: A browser-based, car-soccer-style game wrapper. Control a vehicle, chase the ball, and try to score. This supplied file may be a fan-made or simplified version rather than the official Rocket League game.
games.controls: Keyboard · Follow the in-game instructions for movement and actions

games.title: Tomb of the Mask
games.blurb: Race through a maze of traps and corridors in a fast-paced arcade challenge.
games.subtitle: MOVE FAST. AVOID THE TRAPS.
games.description: A fast arcade maze game. Move through corridors, collect items, and avoid hazards as you try to reach the end of each stage.
games.controls: [↑ / ↓ / ← / →] or [W / A / S / D] to move
